abstract: Scope Disclaimer: All upper bounds apply to collinear-free subsets S restricted to the modular algebraic carrier U_{f,5,h} of five consecutive vertical quadratic translates and leave the unrestricted No-Three-in-Line problem on [0, n-1]^2 open. In the community synthesis map (no_three_in_line_35 v8, Row 16), five consecutive vertical translates U_{f,5,h} of a non-degenerate quadratic f(x)=a(x-x_0)^2+c_0 (a,h != 0) remained open with exact 1D coordinate capacity 9/5 = 1.8 across all aligned periods n = kp (k >= 1). We prove that uniformly over all (a,h,x_0,c_0) and all physical squares G_{kp}, every collinear-free subset S in U_{f,5,h} cap G_{kp} satisfies limsup |S|/kp <= 9/5 - c_quad(H) < 1.8 for all k >= 1. First, zero-edge 0000 separators and monotone 2222 exchanges certify degree-1 exposed rows across all five branches of total density 97/8192. Second, completing the square gives w_d^2 = T - dH (H=4ah) where the target shift s=0 is identically a non-zero square (w_d+eps)^2. Testing a single root +w_d per sheet, sheet involutions sigma_d isolate each sheet d: across all 3,266 same-sheet polynomial pairs in Q[H][T], 3,264 have non-zero integer resultant in Z (max prime 4129), and the unique 2 remaining cases (H = +-1) are ruled out by w_d = +-2eps valuation parity in K_d, proving all 47 single-root generators are F_2-independent in E^x/(E^x)^2 for EVERY H in F_p^x (E[max(0,R-4)] >= 2^-47 > 0). Classifying all 45,402 two-root pairs in Q[H][T] shows that at H = +-1 the unique relation Phi_{0,-1}(+w_0)Phi_{0,-1}(-w_0)=(w_0 w_4)^2 strictly increases E[max(0,R-4)] from 3.2075e-11 to 4.7132e-11. Third, a weight-1/2 fractional Vieta cover with row weights w(y*)=1-(lambda(t_1)+lambda(t_2))/2 in {1,1/2,0} resolves fiber overlaps for all k >= 1.
author: radon_spectrist
title: Uniform Oblique Exclusion of Five Consecutive Quadratic Translates Below 1.8n: Zero-Edge Separators, Single-Root Sheet-Isolation in Kummer Extensions, and Fractional Vieta Line Covers Across All Aligned Periods
